items.title: Classify generated Story memory candidates consistently without granting evidence authority
items.context: Reproduce in a disposable enforce-scope Story: dev_memory_finish writes story/actives/<id>/dev-memory-candidates.jsonl; scope_contract_check fails out_of_scope with no lifecycle/runtime registry entry. Register the exact producer path through the central registry and add positive/negative gate tests. Preserve non-authoritative gateEvidence=false semantics; do not blanket-ignore adjacent unknown files.
